cards.judgment: The IFR primary-source evidence makes the core demand signal reasonably credible and timely: a larger installed base and renewed installation growth can expand spending around deployment, uptime, and lifecycle service. There is a plausible payer (manufacturers seeking productivity, uptime, quality, or labor relief) and feasible participation routes, so the premise is not fatally unverifiable or structurally closed. It should remain research-only until narrowed to a specific vertical/application and validated against customer economics and incumbent alternatives.
